title: Wikis
createWikiDescription: A set of pages that link to each other — a handbook, a reference, the answers to what people keep asking. Name it now; the pages come next.
namePlaceholder: Team handbook, World bible, House rules...
noWikisDescription: A wiki is pages that link to each other. Write one, link it to the next, and the shape of what you know shows up on its own.
notFoundDescription: The wiki you're looking for does not exist or has been removed.
noAccessDescription: You do not have permission to view this wiki.

pages.title: Pages
pages.deleteDescription: Its sub-pages go with it. You can restore them from the trash.
pages.emptyDescription: Start with one page. Link to another with [[ and it will be made when you follow it.
pages.notFound: That page is not in this wiki
pages.nav: Pages either side of this one

settings.title: Wiki settings
settings.orderDescription: How pages sit under each other in the sidebar.
settings.orderManual: The order you put them in
settings.orderManualHint: Drag pages where you want them. Best for something read front to back.
settings.orderTitleHint: Best once there are more pages than anyone wants to arrange.
settings.orderRecentHint: Best for notes and decisions, where the newest matters most.
settings.contentsDescription: How many heading levels the contents list shows.
settings.connections: Show what links to a page
settings.connectionsHint: The list at the foot of every page. Turn it off for a wiki nobody cross-references.
settings.widthComfortableHint: Holds prose to a line length you can read without losing your place.
settings.accentHint: Marks this wiki so two open at once are told apart.
settings.templateDescription: Copy a page's contents into every new page. Good for keeping entries the same shape.
settings.readingDescription: How wide a page runs, and what sits beside it.
settings.appearanceDescription: The colour this wiki is recognised by.
settings.pagesDescription: Where the wiki opens, and what a new page starts from.
settings.homeDescription: The page the wiki opens on.
settings.updatedHint: A handbook people act on needs this; a world bible does not.

page.useAsTemplate: Use as the template for new pages
page.isTemplate: New pages start from this one
